subject: [PATCH v2 06/10] mm/madvise: separate huge PMDs from the PTE walk

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch separates the handling of huge PMDs from the PTE walk in the madvise_lru_pmd_entry function. It introduces a new function, madvise_lru_huge_pmd(), which takes care of advising or splitting huge folios and reclaiming them when necessary. This change improves code organization and reduces complexity by separating concerns related to huge PMDs and PTE walks.
